bank.title: Python for Data Analysis - Official Ministry QBank

questions.question:
You are analyzing customer records. The customer ID must remain unchanged even if it contains
leading zeros, such as "001245". Which data type should you use?

You have a list of company departments that users may modify during the program. Which data
structure is most appropriate?

You need to store an employee's information so that "EmployeeID" maps to 1025, "Name" maps to
"Ahmed", and "Salary" maps to 75000. Which structure is most appropriate?

A sales list contains:
sales = [1200, 1500, 1800, 2100, 2500, 3000]
You need only the second through fifth values. Which expression should you use?

You receive the following matrix:
data = [
[10, 20, 30],
[40, 50, 60],
[70, 80, 90]
]
You need to access the value 80. Which expression is correct?

A company classifies employees according to salary:
•   Less than 30,000 → Junior
•   30,000–59,999 → Mid-Level
•   60,000 or more → Senior
Which structure is most appropriate?

You need to process every transaction in a list and calculate its total. Which Python structure is most
appropriate?

You have:
sales = [100, 250, 50, 400, 80]
You need a new list containing only sales greater than 100. Which expression is correct?

options.text: [x for x in sales if x > 100]
[x if x > 100 for x in sales]

questions.question:
You are creating a reusable function to calculate an employee's annual salary from monthly salary.
Which implementation is best?

A reporting function should accept a tax rate but use 0.10 when the user doesn't provide one. Which
definition is appropriate?

You need a function whose calculated result can be reused later in another calculation. Should the
function primarily use:

A data-entry program converts user input into an integer. Some users may enter text instead of a
number. Which structure should be used to prevent the program from crashing?

You have one million numerical measurements and need efficient mathematical operations. Which
library is most appropriate for the underlying numerical array operations?

Consider:
import numpy as np
data = np.array([
[10, 20, 30],
[40, 50, 60]
])
What is data.shape?

Using the same array:
data = np.array([
[10, 20, 30],
[40, 50, 60]
])
Which expression returns 50?

You need to calculate the average temperature from a NumPy array called temperatures. Which
function should you use?

A matrix contains sales for multiple products and months. You want the total for each column.
Which approach is appropriate?

You have 12 values stored in a one-dimensional NumPy array and need to organize them into 3
rows and 4 columns. Which statement is correct?

You have:
prices = np.array([50, 120, 80, 200, 150])
You need all prices greater than 100. Which expression is correct?

You receive a CSV containing 500,000 customer records. You want a table-like structure with rows
and columns for analysis. Which Pandas object should you use?
You receive a file called sales.csv. Which command correctly loads it into Pandas?

You receive an unfamiliar DataFrame and want to quickly inspect its columns, data types, non-null
counts, and memory usage. Which method is most appropriate?

You want a statistical summary containing values such as count, mean, standard deviation,
minimum, quartiles, and maximum for numerical columns. Which method should you use?

A DataFrame contains:
Name
Department
Salary
Age
You need only Name and Salary. Which expression is correct?

You need employees who work in Finance or Sales and earn more than 60,000. Which expression
is correct?
Management wants the total sales for every region. Which approach is most appropriate?

You need the total sales, average sales, and number of transactions for each region. Which
approach is most appropriate?

The sales manager wants the top-performing products listed from highest sales to lowest. Which
statement is correct?

A DataFrame contains missing values in the Salary column. You decide that missing salaries should
be replaced with the median salary rather than deleted. Which approach is appropriate?

Before cleaning a dataset, you need to determine how many missing values exist in each column.
Which expression is most appropriate?

A customer dataset contains duplicate customer records. You want to remove completely duplicated
rows. Which method should you use?

A company considers CustomerID to be unique. You want to identify duplicate CustomerIDs rather
than checking whether entire rows are duplicates. Which approach is appropriate?

Which statement correctly creates a variable named
age with the value 25?

Customer names contain inconsistent spaces:
" Ahmed "
"Sarah"
" John Smith "
Which operation removes leading and trailing whitespace?

A Gender column contains:
Male
male
MALE
Female
female
You want to standardize the values to lowercase before further processing. Which operation is
appropriate?

A salary dataset contains extreme values. You want a statistical method based on the first and third
quartiles to identify potential outliers. Which method should you use?

You have two DataFrames:
Customers
CustomerID | Name | Region
and
Orders
OrderID | CustomerID | Amount
You need to combine them using CustomerID. Which Pandas function should you use?

What is the output?
x = 10
print(x > 5)

You have January, February, and March sales DataFrames with the same columns. You want to
stack them vertically into one dataset. Which function is most appropriate?

You need to visualize monthly revenue over time to identify trends. Which chart is generally most
appropriate?

Management wants to compare total sales between five regions. Which chart is generally most
appropriate?

You want to investigate whether advertising expenditure is associated with sales revenue. Which
visualization is most appropriate?

You need to understand the distribution of customer ages, including whether the distribution is
concentrated around particular ranges. Which chart should you use?

You want to compare salary distributions across departments and identify potential extreme salary
values. Which Seaborn visualization is most appropriate?

You have numerical columns including:
Age
Income
Spending
CreditScore
You want to visualize the correlation between these variables using color intensity. Which approach is
most appropriate?

You want to examine the relationship between Age and Spending, while using different colors for
customer segments. Which Seaborn function is particularly suitable?

You receive a sales dataset containing:
•     Duplicate rows
•     Missing revenue
•     Revenue stored as text
•     Extra spaces in customer names
•     Inconsistent region capitalization
•     Extreme revenue values
What should generally happen before creating the final analytical charts?

options.text: Create charts first and clean later
Clean and validate the data before performing the final analysis and visualization
Delete every row containing any missing value automatically
Convert every column to a string

questions.question:
You are asked to identify the top 5 regions by average order value, but the dataset contains multiple
orders per customer. Which approach is most appropriate?

options.text:
Group by region, calculate the appropriate order-level/customer-level metric, and then sort the
resulting aggregated DataFrame
Sort the raw data and take the first five rows

questions.question:
You are given a large customer-sales dataset and asked to produce a management dashboard. The
data contains missing values, duplicates, incorrect data types, inconsistent text, and outliers. You must
determine the most profitable regions, analyze customer segments, identify relationships between
variables, and produce professional visualizations.
Which workflow represents the best overall data-analysis process?

options.text: Load data → immediately create charts → remove errors after presenting results

Load data with Pandas → inspect structure and data quality → clean missing values, duplicates, text
and data types → investigate outliers → merge required datasets → perform exploratory analysis with
Pandas/NumPy → calculate KPIs → create appropriate Matplotlib/Seaborn visualizations → validate
results
Load data → convert every column to text → create pie charts → export results
Load data → delete all rows containing missing values → use only NumPy → create one bar chart
